__NOTOC__{{Quest infobox | map = [[File:Attack at the Kodash map.jpg|250px]] | campaign = Nightfall | region = Vabbi | type = Primary | required hero = Koss | required hero2 = Melonni | given by = [[Zerai the Learner]] | given at = [[the Kodash Bazaar]] | preceded by = [[Grand Court of Sebelkeh]] | followed by = [[Heart or Mind: Garden in Danger]]
[[Heart or Mind: Ronjok in Danger]] }} The [[Grand Forum of Vabb]] of [[The Kodash Bazaar]] is under attack! Go and help defend it with the aid of the [[Djinn]]. ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== * Required heroes: [[Koss]] and [[Melonni]]. ===Objectives=== *Take Koss and Melonni to speak with [[Butoh the Bold]] to prepare the defenses of the Grand Forum of Vabb. (Koss and Melonni must be equipped heroes) *Help defend the Grand Forum of Vabb. If it should fall, so will the Kodash Bazaar. *Speak with Butoh the Bold. *See [[Zerai the Learner]] for your reward. ===Reward=== *2,500 [[Experience]] *250 [[Gold]] *10 [[Lightbringer Points]] ==Walkthrough== Start in The Kodash Bazaar. Head out southwest and walk to Butoh the Bold. After talking to him, five groups of [[Margonite]]s will spawn one after each other. Don't wait in the center for them to arrive, but head directly toward the first group in the southwest. The [[Ruby Djinn]] will help you, therefore it is a good idea to heal them. Proceed with the next groups. Don't worry about Margonites massing in the center, they won't do anything until/unless you're in aggro range. After killing all groups, talk again to Butoh the Bold. Map back to The Kodash Bazaar for your reward. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== [[Elemental]]s ([[Djinn]]) *{{e}} 24 [[Ruby Djinn]] ===Foes=== [[Demon]]s ([[Margonite]]s) *{{w}} 24 [[Margonite Executioner]] *{{r}} 24 [[Margonite Bowmaster]] *{{mo}} 24 [[Margonite Cleric]] *{{n}} 24 [[Margonite Warlock]] *{{me}} 24 [[Margonite Seer]] *{{p}} 24 [[Margonite Ascendant]] *{{d}} 24 [[Margonite Reaper]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Zerai the Learner :''"[[Varesh]]'s crusade west through [[the Desolation]] has weakened the barrier between our world and the [[Realm of Torment|nightmare realm]]. Already, many suffer terrible nightmares as [[Abaddon]] takes advantage of their fears and secrets. It is true. Nightfall is at hand. No doubt they will try to overtake the [[Grand Forum of Vabb]], and with it the '''[[Kodash Bazaar]]'''. I have been instructed to use the Djinn of [[The Hidden City of Ahdashim|Ahdashim]] to protect key areas. Go with '''Koss''' and '''Melonni''' to speak with '''Butoh the Bold'''. Tell him the djinn will help protect things. He is a great fighter and will know how best to use them in battle. Will you help us one more time, hero?"'' {{offer dialog |accept = Without a doubt. |decline = I'm sure Vabbi is safe. |ask = '''Butoh the Bold''' is in '''[[Forum Highlands]]''', just outside the '''Kodash Bazaar'''. }} ===Intermediate dialogue=== ;Butoh the Bold :''"Ah, great heroes indeed. These djinn that Zerai sent will come in handy. I have stationed them at the edges of the forum. I fear an attack will come all too soon. Several merchants suffering from terrible nightmares have already fled. I fear they will serve as conduits for Abaddon's forces. Here they come!"'' ;Whenever a Margonite group spawns :'''Butoh the Bold:''' ''"Here they come!"'' :'''Butoh the Bold:''' ''"[[Lyssa]] protect us!"'' :'''Butoh the Bold:''' ''"They're everywhere!"'' :'''Butoh the Bold:''' ''"Get behind the Djinn!"'' ===[[Attack at the Kodash (cinematic)|Cinematic]]=== :'''Koss:''' ''"Melonni? What's the matter?"'' :'''Melonni:''' ''"Koss! I've had a horrible vision. I saw my village, [[Ronjok]], surrounded by these tendrils and transformed into a nightmare realm."'' :'''Koss:''' ''"Sounds like a bad dream."'' :'''Melonni:''' ''"Not a dream. More like an intrusion. A warning. Like I was in someone else's nightmare."'' :'''Koss:''' ''"Those tendrils are bad, but they seem to have stabilized."'' :''':''' ''"No, Melonni is right. I have been told the [[Garden of Seborhin]] has been transformed by these things. It has fallen into night."'' :'''Koss:''' ''"The garden? We must go there at once."'' :'''Melonni:''' ''"No. If it happened here, it happened in Ronjok as well. We must go there instead."'' :'''Koss:''' ''"Melonni, no! We need to address a real problem, not a silly dream."'' :'''Melonni:''' ''"Not a dream. A vision. My village has risked everything on our behalf. They're more important than a few plants."'' :'''Koss:''' ''"The garden is very important to the princes. We've worked hard to make them our allies."'' :'''Melonni:''' ''"Allies? You just care about wealthy princes instead of ordinary people."'' :'''Koss:''' ''"I care about a real threat, not about some distracting dream!"'' :'''Melonni:''' ''"Not a dream, a vision! You're just being stubborn!"'' :'''Koss:''' ''"You think you're always right!"'' :''':''' ''"Enough!"'' :'''Melonni:''' ''"You lead our party, and I will abide by your decision. You must choose which way we go."'' :'''Koss:''' ''"Agreed. You lead and I shall follow. Which will it be - the garden or the village?"'' ===Intermediate dialogue=== ;Butoh the Bold :''"Zerai and [[Prince Mehtu the Wise|Mehtu the Wise]] have indeed saved the day; as have all of you. It seems you now have to make a choice. Before you do, speak with Zerai. He will see that you are amply rewarded for your courage. I have not seen a fight like that since [[Prince Ahmtur the Mighty|Ahmtur the Mighty]] last cleared the halls of Ahdashim. May Lyssa protect us from Nightfall."'' ===Reward dialgoue=== ;Zerai the Learner :''"Please take this as thanks. I fear this is only the beginning. The Garden of Seborhin has fallen and Ronjok may be in peril. It seems you must now make a choice, hero."'' ==Notes== * A paragon with [["They're on Fire!"]] will greatly reduce the damage dealt by the Margonites. * If you have the quest [[Norgu's Nightfall]] active, Butoh the Bold will not spawn. {{bug|Sometimes even after killing all groups that have spawned you still won't complete the quest. This might be caused by one of the Vabbian Commoners being stuck behind a Vabbian Chest.}} [[Category:Rewards Lightbringer points]]
